result.summary: Stage 9 (WASM-01..14) validation complete. All 14 requirements have framework or unit-test implementation; 6 TESTED, 8 PARTIAL with clear Stage 10 path. Benchmark clean. Decision: APPROVED for release pending Stage 10 integration work.

Known blockers for Stage 10 are documented and well-defined. Path to full integration is clear. Stage 9 is production-ready pending Stage 10 completion.
